title: CroCoMAE: Cross-modal self-supervised collaborative representation learning for SAR-optical remote sensing data
abstract: arXiv:2611.14124v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Remote sensing increasingly captures the Earth's surface through complementary sensors such as SAR and optical, yet ground-truth annotations remain scarce, limiting supervised approaches. Self-supervised learning (SSL) addresses the label scarcity, and cross-modal SSL further exploits the complementarity between co-located sensors, but existing cross-modal frameworks align modalities mostly through global image-level representations or treat them as largely redundant, leaving their fine-grained complementary structure underexploited. We propose CroCoMAE, a cross-modal SSL framework for SAR-optical remote sensing that unifies contrastive learning and masked image modeling within a ViT-based architecture, operating at two complementary levels. translated_title: CroCoMAE：面向SAR-光学遥感数据的跨模态自监督协同表示学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.14124v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：遥感领域越来越多地通过SAR和光学等互补传感器来捕捉地球表面，然而地面真值标注仍然稀缺，限制了监督方法的应用。自监督学习（SSL）解决了标注稀缺的问题，而跨模态自监督学习进一步利用了共址部署传感器之间的互补性，但现有的跨模态框架主要通过全局图像级表示来对齐不同模态，或将各模态视为基本冗余的，导致其细粒度的互补结构未被充分挖掘。我们提出CroCoMAE，一个面向SAR-光学遥感的跨模态自监督学习框架，它在基于ViT的架构中统一了对比学习与掩码图像建模，并在两个互补的层面上运行。在图像层面，作用于类标记（class token）的模态内对比损失可产生具有全局判别性且对数据增强不变的表示；在补丁层面，掩码图像建模驱动细粒度的……
tldr: 提出CroCoMAE框架，在基于ViT的架构中统一对比学习与掩码图像建模，从图像级和补丁级两个互补层面挖掘SAR-光学遥感数据的细粒度跨模态互补结构，实现自监督协同表示学习。
en_tdlr: CroCoMAE unifies contrastive learning and masked image modeling within a ViT-based architecture to exploit the fine-grained cross-modal complementarity of SAR-optical remote sensing data at both the image and patch levels.
